generic.label: Comprehensive CV
generic.tagline: Applied AI | Generative AI | Wireless Networks | Research and Engineering
generic.headline: Machine Learning Engineer | AI, Wireless Systems & Research
generic.summary: AI/ML and Generative AI Engineer with a PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering and 7+ years of experience developing data-driven systems across enterprise, industry, and research environments. Experience includes LLM-enabled analytics, AI-ready data pipelines, domain-adaptive machine learning, and scalable cloud solutions using Python, SQL, Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, and Azure services. At AT&T, lead development and operational integration of AI solutions for critical service-assurance workflows, improving automated diagnostic accuracy from 20% to 80%. Combine model evaluation, data quality, ETL, and cross-functional delivery to translate technical requirements into production-oriented AI capabilities. Research experience spans wireless-network intelligence, simulation, transfer learning, and experimental platforms, alongside teaching and mentorship.

skills.Generative & Agentic AI: LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, semantic retrieval, structured information extraction, tool-using agents, agent orchestration, and grounded response generation
skills.Microsoft AI Ecosystem: Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Foundry models and agents, Azure Content Understanding, Semantic Kernel, and responsible AI concepts
skills.LLM Frameworks & Models: Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI APIs, transformer architectures, fine-tuning concepts, NLP foundation models, prompt templates, structured outputs, and LLM evaluation
skills.Data & AI Platforms: Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Functions, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Data Lake, Google BigQuery, and cloud analytics workflows
skills.Data Engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, AI-ready datasets, batch processing, ingestion, cleansing, schema transformation, validation, feature engineering, data-quality assessment, and structured and unstructured data workflows
skills.Machine Learning: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, transfer learning, domain adaptation, adversarial learning, anomaly detection, classification, regression, time-series forecasting, cross-validation, and model evaluation
skills.MLOps & Software Engineering: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, REST APIs, Flask, testing, Linux, shell scripting, model deployment, reproducible workflows, and cloud-native application development
skills.Programming & Analytics: Python, SQL, C/C++, and R; Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Statsmodels, Matplotlib, Plotly, Streamlit, Jupyter, and exploratory data analysis
skills.Wireless Systems: LTE/5G-NR, NR-NTN, cell selection, user timing in 5G standalone networks, RAN optimization, mobility, propagation modeling, and service assurance
skills.Wireless AI & Optimization: Transfer learning, domain adaptation, adversarial learning, autoencoder-based CSI compression, GAN-based data generation, reinforcement learning, self-healing, and outage management
skills.Simulation & Experimentation: Python simulation platforms, 3GPP-compliant network simulation, AI-enabled 5G testbeds, diagnostic logs, measurement analysis, robustness testing, and systematic experimentation

leadership.Ownership and accountability: Lead AI/ML initiatives through requirements analysis, data preparation, model development, validation, stakeholder review, and deployment planning.

leadership.Cross-functional collaboration: Work with software engineers, network specialists, researchers, geologists, and public-safety stakeholders to translate domain requirements into practical data and AI solutions.
leadership.Continuous learning: Apply ongoing study in generative AI, agentic AI, RAG, LLM evaluation, and cloud-native platforms through hands-on projects and professional coursework.
leadership.Reliability and commitment: Maintain reproducible workflows, careful validation, and attention to detail throughout experimentation and delivery.
leadership.Adaptability and problem solving: Combine critical thinking, systematic experimentation, and data-driven analysis to address unfamiliar technologies and complex operational problems.

faculty.label: Faculty & Academic
faculty.tagline: AI for Wireless Networks | Reliable Learning Systems | Wearable Intelligence | Engineering Education
faculty.headline: Researcher & Engineering Educator | AI, Wireless Systems & Applied Machine Learning
faculty.summary: Researcher and engineering educator with a PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering and experience spanning AI-enabled wireless networks, reliable machine learning, network resilience, propagation modeling, optimization, and wearable intelligence. Academic work combines analytical modeling, large-scale simulation, experimental validation, and data-driven methods, complemented by industry research at AT&T Labs and Futurewei and applied ML engineering in telecommunications. Research and teaching interests connect artificial intelligence with wireless and connected systems, dependable automation, and human-centered sensing.

skills.Research Areas: AI for wireless networks, resilient and autonomous networks, propagation modeling, digital twins, RAN optimization, wearable intelligence, and data-efficient learning
skills.Machine Learning: Deep learning, transfer learning, domain adaptation, adversarial learning, generative modeling, reinforcement learning, classification, time-series analysis, and model evaluation
skills.Wireless Systems: LTE/4G, 5G-NR, NTN, mobility, radio access networks, propagation, outage management, network measurements, and service assurance
skills.Research Methods: Experimental design, simulation, statistical analysis, cross-validation, robustness evaluation, reproducible workflows, and technical communication
skills.Engineering & Data: Python, SQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Pandas, NumPy, cloud analytics, data pipelines, and visualization
skills.Teaching & Mentoring: Wireless communications, digital communications, networking, signals and systems, machine learning, programming, experimental methods, and student research development

leadership.Research leadership: Develop research questions into reproducible modeling, simulation, experimentation, validation, and publication workflows.
leadership.Teaching and mentoring: Connect engineering fundamentals with applied examples and support students in technical problem solving, implementation, experimentation, and communication.
leadership.Industry translation: Bridge academic methods with practical telecommunications problems through experience in university research and industry R&D environments.
leadership.Interdisciplinary collaboration: Work across wireless communications, machine learning, data science, and wearable sensing while communicating results to technical and domain stakeholders.
leadership.Persistence and rigor: Approach difficult research problems through systematic experimentation, careful validation, iterative refinement, and attention to reproducibility.
leadership.Continuous development: Extend teaching and research capability through ongoing study in generative AI, agentic systems, cloud engineering, and emerging wireless technologies.
